jobs.full_reason: A new FLOOR release is appended whole, not only the floors whose content changed; a run with no new release writes nothing (2026-10-29: persisted_row_count=0). The hub lanes compare since root ADR-0318; this lane does not yet.
jobs.full_cost: measured 2026-10-29 from silver.building_register_floors$snapshots (read-only Trino): the 2026-10-20 release appended 21,189,570 rows, 1.065 GB in one commit, half of the table's 2.138 GB; one release a month.
jobs.full_tracked_by: root ADR-0322 §3 and its progress notes (the FLOOR lane compares like the hub lanes, ordered by ADR-0328; natural row ids are done in #932); its tracking PR #952 was folded there
jobs.description: 최신 complete Bronze FLOOR/title pair를 매일 재확인하고 FLOOR Silver 적재를 재시도한다. source_sweep의 신규 수집 건수와 독립적이다. 이력 검사와 적재는 Spark 없이 발행기 안의 DuckDB 가 한다: 이미 실린 판이면 검사에서 끝나고, 아니면 제어 컨테이너가 판을 내보내고 발행기가 판 전체를 한 커밋으로 덧붙인다(root ADR-0599). Spark 풀이 아니라 documents 풀에서 한 번에 하나씩, 자기 유닛의 memory_claim 으로 들어간다.

expected_outcome.basis: building HUB files are released monthly (expected_cadence monthly, 1080 h, in the endpoint catalog) plus one daily fallback; measured 2026-11-11 from each unit's journal, 10-12..11-11 (read-only): changed 9 of 21 runs, the last on the 10-20 release.
